title.label: Title
title.hint: Say what the agent should do, in one line.

deadline.label: Deadline (optional)
deadline.hint: Today or later. The brief stays open after it passes until you close it.

form.publicNote: Your brief is public. Your contacts are shown only to signed-in members.
form.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?

tips.title: What makes a good brief
tips.task: Describe the task, not the technology. “Take orders from WhatsApp” beats “build a GPT bot”.
tips.tools: Name the tools you already use: Google Sheets, Telegram, 1C, Instagram.
tips.numbers: Give numbers: how many messages, orders or files per day.
tips.lifecycle: You can close the brief when you find a creator, and reopen it later if you need more offers.

errors.titleLength: The title must be 3 to 100 characters.
errors.contentLength: The description must be 20 to 3000 characters.
errors.budgetRequired: Enter a budget, or tick “Open to offers”.
errors.budgetPositive: The budget must be greater than 0.
errors.deadlineFuture: Pick today or a later date.
errors.gone: This brief was deleted or is no longer yours.
